prompt: Which is the most recent film to dominate the British Academy Film Awards by winning more than seven awards while also having the most total wins and nominations in its award year?
answer: **The Killing Fields** (1984) is the most recent film fitting that description. At the **38th British Academy Film Awards** in 1985, it won **eight awards**—the most of any film that year—and received **13 nominations**, also the year’s highest total.
